title: PermissionChange
description: A record of a change to security permissions within the Workday tenant, including security group membership changes, domain security policy modifications, and role assignment updates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the permission change record

changeDateTime.description: Timestamp when the permission change was made

id.description: Unique identifier of the affected security group

descriptor.description: Display name of the affected security group

domain.description: The Workday domain affected by the change if applicable

previousPermission.description: The permission level before the change

newPermission.description: The permission level after the change

affectedAccount.description: The user account affected by the permission change if applicable

description.description: Human-readable description of the permission change
